name: Site Under Construction
author: BDPlugins

sections.description:
The Site Under Construction plugin allows you to quickly put your WordPress site into maintenance mode. When enabled, visitors will see a customizable “Site Under Construction” message, while administrators can continue to view and work on the site as usual.

Features:
– Enable or disable the “Site Under Construction” mode with a checkbox.
– Customize the message displayed to visitors.
– Seamlessly integrates with the WordPress tools page.
– Change 4 modern coming soon template.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ -> ‘General’ to configure the “Coming Soon” settings.
sections.faq:
Who will see the “Site Under Construction” message?

Visitors to your site who are not logged in as administrators will see the message. Administrators can view the site as usual.

Can I customize the message?

Yes, you can customize the “Site Under Construction” message from the General Settings page.

How do I enable or disable the “Site Under Construction” mode?

You can enable or disable the mode by checking or unchecking the checkbox in the General Settings page.
